question: This is a printer device management system. First, it needs to maintain basic information of printer manufacturers (name, person in charge). Each model belongs to a specific manufacturer and includes standard driver configurations for that printer model. For each specific printer device, the system needs to record which model it is, where it is installed, and its network hostname. Some printers may need personalized driver settings in addition to the standard driver configuration.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0218

CREATE TABLE manufacturers (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  person_in_charge VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE printer_models (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  manufacturer_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  model_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  standard_driver_config VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (manufacturer_id) REFERENCES manufacturers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE printers (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  model_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  location VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  hostname VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  personalized_driver_settings VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES printer_models (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
